watches.description: Introducing our 2025 new release: the American Railroad Collection. This collection pays tribute to the vital role midwestern railroads played in shaping local history, turning small towns into thriving centers of industry and culture. Inspired by the early railway systems that powered the Midwest’s growth—and the legacy of historic railroad-grade pocket watches from Springfield, IL—it embodies the resilience and ingenuity that are at the heart of our region. At Sangamon Watches, every timepiece is entirely designed, hand-assembled, and meticulously tested by local expert watchmakers right here in Springfield, IL. These watches blend timeless craftsmanship with modern precision, offering rugged elegance and dependable functionality. Whether you're celebrating the rich history of midwestern railroads or searching for a reliable companion for daily adventures, the American Railroad Collection is a true testament to our local heritage and enduring American progress. watches.name: "Salisbury Collection" Fixed-Blade Hunting Knife - Walnut Handle
watches.description: History Behind The Salisbury Collection ONLY 1 LEFT! The gorgeous walnut handle was sourced from David Ingram, a local craftsman from Salisbury, Illinois. Salisbury is located just 12 miles northwest of Springfield and 8 miles south of New Salem and is close to the historic Sangamo Town settlement where Abraham Lincoln built his flatboat in 1831. The walnut used in the handle originates from an area that was well-known to Lincoln as it is along the "Lincoln Trail" that he traveled between Springfield and New Salem. It's exciting to think that Lincoln might have fished, hunted, or courted his first love in the same region where this beautiful walnut was sourced. Although we cannot make a direct connection between the wood and Lincoln, we can take inspiration from his adventurous spirit. Salisbury is a hidden gem with breathtaking Midwestern scenery, including rivers, hills, and some of the most fertile land in the world. The Sangamon team was brought to Brian Su's rural ranch in Salisbury and their lives have been forever impacted by the experience. A special thanks to our colleague Mark Bennett for his invaluable advice during the design and research process. Introducing a remarkable hand-forged recreational and hunting knife, boasting top-grade Japanese VG-10/67-layer Damascus Steel and a locally sourced walnut handle. The walnut handle was crafted by local artisan David Ingram, who harvested and processed the wood from Salisbury, Illinois. This limited-edition fixed-blade knife is sharp and durable, with a premium hardness rating of 60 HRC. The knife also comes with a hand-stitched veg-tanned Argentine leather sheath. FREE USA SHIPPING! Details Blade: Japanese VG-10/67-layer Damascus Steel Handle: Walnut from Salisbury, IL Bone: Camel Bone from Mongolia Sheath: Hand Stitched Veg-Tanned Argentine Leather Total length: 8.66 inches (22cm) Handle length: 4.33 inches (11cm) Blade length: 4.33 inches (11cm) Blade width: 1.18 inches (3cm) Blade thickness: 4 mm Packaging: Premium Black Magnetic Closure Box & Story Card Limited Edition: 100 knives Warranty: 1 Year Care Instructions - Clean your knife after each use with warm soapy water. It is important to especially clean the knife after cutting any acidic foods such as lemons, limes, tomatoes, etc. - Do not ever leave your knife in soaking water. - Keep the knife as dry as possible to preserve the integrity of the walnut. - Safely sharpen your knife. A dull knife is more dangerous than a sharp knife. - We recommend you store the knife outside the leather sheath if storing away for a long time. International Shipping We do not ship knife orders to international destinations.

watches.name: Omaha Beach - Black/Sand
watches.description: The Omaha Beach Collection pays tribute to the valiant soldiers who fought for freedom during one of the deadliest battles of the 20th century. The watch features an engraved design on its back that depicts a soldier charging onto the beach during the crucial victory of World War II. The 24 stars symbolize the approximately 2400 American casualties that occurred at Omaha Beach on June 6, 1944, as reported by the United States European Command. This is a limited edition model, with only 500 watches available. And, as a bonus, shipping within the USA is free. As a part of the Freedom Series, the Omaha Beach Collection recognizes and honors the heroes who fought for liberty. The Freedom Series is a celebration of American bravery and serves as a source of inspiration to be courageous, much like the freedom fighters who have come before us. watches.name: Lincoln's River - Gold Silver
watches.description: Abraham Lincoln, widely recognized by historians as America's most iconic president, started his journey as a common Midwesterner facing challenges at every turn. The back of this limited-edition watch, part of the New Beginnings Series, depicts a thrilling moment from 1831 when Lincoln navigated down the Sangamon River and, despite getting his boat stuck on a mill dam, showed his ingenuity and leadership skills to impress the onlookers. Each of the 500 Sangamon timepieces comes with a historic story card to deepen the connection with this inspirational story. The New Beginnings Series symbolizes the launch of new endeavors that change the direction of our lives, fueling excitement and inspiring us to be our best selves. FREE USA Shipping!
